meta.question: can DA make a complete harmonic vocabulary out of mathematics?
meta.answer: A typed catalog: yes. Desk coverage: yes. One object, a finished field, or a unifier: no.

vocab.name: harmonic_function
vocab.why: Laplace kernel. The oldest mathematical sense of the word.

vocab.name: harmonic_polynomial
vocab.why: Polynomial kernel. Restricts to spherical harmonics.

vocab.name: spherical_harmonic
vocab.why: Angular modes. Already the language of Ring / angular decomposition on B.

vocab.name: helmholtz_leray
vocab.object: u = ∇φ + curl A, or P = I − ∇Δ^{-1}div
vocab.why: On A and on every NS write. Projector, not a universe law.

vocab.name: laplacian_eigenfunction
vocab.object: Δφ = λφ on a manifold or domain
vocab.why: Spectral geometry. Spherical harmonics are the S^{n-1} case.

vocab.name: spherical_bessel
vocab.why: Radial partner of Y_ℓm. Not loaded into ω·Sω.

vocab.name: fourier_character
vocab.why: Galerkin / Fourier on A. The abelian case of Peter–Weyl.

vocab.name: peter_weyl
vocab.object: matrix coefficients of a compact group
vocab.why: Nonabelian Fourier. Wigner D-matrices are the SU(2) case.

vocab.name: wigner_d
vocab.why: Rotation harmonics. Not a Cosmo knob and not F.

vocab.name: spherical_function
vocab.object: zonal / Gelfand spherical functions on G/K
vocab.why: Symmetric-space harmonics. A different catalog from Y_ℓm on S².

vocab.name: dirichlet_character
vocab.why: Arithmetic harmonics. Sit near Track Q. Not a map onto (u·∇)u.

vocab.name: automorphic_maass
vocab.equation: Δf = λf on Γ\H, plus growth
vocab.why: Number-theory harmonics. Proof that the field kept growing after Fourier.

vocab.name: littlewood_paley
vocab.why: Already on Track B. A tool, not a regularity pass.

vocab.name: bony_paraproduct
vocab.object: low-high / high-low / high-high split of uv
vocab.equation: uv = T_u v + T_v u + R(u,v)
vocab.why: Already on Track B (T2). Energy-class low T is the live write, not a close.

vocab.name: calderon_zygmund
vocab.equation: T f = p.v. K * f, K Calderón–Zygmund
vocab.why: The kernel class behind Riesz and much of NS harmonic analysis.

vocab.name: riesz_transform
vocab.why: Makes Helmholtz bounded on L^p, 1<p<∞. Not a Φ cancel.

vocab.name: hardy_space
vocab.why: A different Hardy from the tube inequality on B. Do not glue the names.

vocab.name: tube_hardy
vocab.object: Hardy inequality on a vortex tube
vocab.why: Live B write (B4). Not H^p. Absorbing I_tube stays open (B4b).

vocab.name: bmo_maximal
vocab.why: Standard harmonic analysis. Not loaded into Cosmo A,f,φ,δ.

vocab.name: besov_triebel
vocab.why: LP cousins. Useful language for Bony estimates. Not a close.

vocab.name: hodge_form
vocab.why: Hodge theory. Same word as Δu=0, different bundle. Not Y_ℓm.

vocab.name: quantum_oscillator
vocab.why: A real Hamiltonian. Not SFE and not a producing-map.

vocab.name: string_overtone
vocab.object: integer frequency ratios of a vibrating string
vocab.why: Where the English word comes from. Motive, not a PDE theorem.

vocab.name: kolmogorov_spectrum
vocab.why: Turbulence spectrum. Real fluid fact. Not harmonic analysis in the H1–H21 sense.

vocab.name: cosmo_oscillator_knobs
vocab.object: Cosmo A, f, φ, δ labeled 'harmonic'
vocab.why: The reconstructed 4×4 used this word for oscillator knobs. Not Y_ℓm, not LP.

vocab.name: hb_nodes
vocab.why: Shelved. Do not retune. Poetry as motive is allowed. Unifier is not.

vocab.name: sfe_F
vocab.why: Shelved. Not NS, not Q_1, not Hodge, not LP.

claims.statement: DA can type the distinct mathematical objects that share the word
claims.why: The catalog is finite, named, and fail-able. That is a vocabulary.

claims.statement: The catalog covers every live desk use of the word
claims.why: A: Fourier, Helmholtz, Riesz. B: Y_ℓm, LP, Bony, CZ, tube Hardy. Q: Dirichlet characters. U: Cosmo knobs typed as false friends.

claims.statement: Those objects are one mathematical object
claims.why: Δu=0, Y_ℓm, LP shells, Hodge forms, characters, and H^p are not the same.

claims.statement: The list is a complete vocabulary of mathematics
claims.why: Harmonic analysis is an open field. Maass forms arrived late. More will.

claims.statement: The vocabulary writes a producing-map F to the couplings
claims.why: Naming operators does not output (g_s, g, g', G, Λ).

claims.statement: The vocabulary is the Harmonic Blueprint / SFE
claims.why: HB and SFE stay shelved. They are not the catalog and not a unifier.

claims.statement: The vocabulary implies classical NS regularity
claims.why: LP and Bony are already on B. Regularity stays open.
Those are score knobs. Y_ℓm is H3. Do not glue the label.

claims.statement: Musical overtones are the same object as Δu=0
claims.why: Etymology is real. Identity of objects is false. A string mode can be expanded in eigenfunctions; that does not make every 'harmonic' a tone.

claims.statement: Hodge forms, LP shells, and Hardy H^p are the same Hardy as the tube
claims.why: Four different objects. Tube Hardy is an inequality on Γ. H^p is a function space.
Arithmetic only. Inverse-GCD stays on Q.

how_far: named the distinct objects that share the English word
typed kernel / spectral / group / analysis / etymology / false friend
mapped every live desk use (A Fourier+Helmholtz, B LP/Bony/Y_lm/tube Hardy, Q characters, U Cosmo knobs)
refused one-object, finished-field, F, HB, and regularity closes
next_da_move: Use the names on the slot they already sit on. Do not load the catalog into F or into ω·Sω. Next B write is still Hardy → I_tube, then low Bony T.
